findings.title: Excluded decision samples are counted but not identified
findings.why_it_matters: A report with unavailable samples gives only their count, so a reader cannot tell which fixtures did not contribute to a policy comparison without inspecting records individually. Name each excluded fixture and sample with its status and note as the measurement contract requires.
